title: Messi vs Ronaldo
shortAnswer: Messi is widely regarded as the more naturally gifted player with superior dribbling and playmaking, while Ronaldo is celebrated for his athleticism, goal-scoring consistency, and aerial dominance. Messi has won 8 Ballon d'Or awards to Ronaldo's 5.
verdict: Both are all-time greats. Messi edges it for overall ability and the 2022 World Cup, while Ronaldo's longevity and Champions League record is unmatched.

lines.hook: Between them, 1,737 career goals. Two men rewrote what a career could look like.
lines.tape: One was voted the best player alive eight times. The other never stopped scoring.
rounds: Eight Ballon d'Ors to five. Nobody else in history has more than five.
899 to 838. Ronaldo scored more goals than any human ever has.
369 assists against 262. Messi didn't just finish moves, he built them.
Five European Cups to four. Ronaldo owned the nights that decide legacies.
One World Cup to none. Messi got the trophy that ends every argument.
lines.verdict: Messi takes it three rounds to two. Want relentless goals and Champions League nights? Ronaldo.

youtubeTitle: Messi vs Ronaldo: The Numbers That Actually Settle It
youtubeDescription: A head-to-head breakdown of Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo across Ballon d'Ors, career goals, assists, Champions League titles and the World Cup. Messi leads on awards, assists and the 2022 trophy, while Ronaldo holds the scoring record and one more European Cup. Five rounds, one verdict.
